# Contents jumps across a reflow

Open Contents, jump to a section, and the section stays at the top of the view when the panel closes and the column widens. The long paragraphs make every width change move the headings.

## 1. The harbour

The harbour keeps its own hours, and the people who work there keep their own **ledger**: what came in, what went out, and what the weather did in between. The entries are short, in *pencil*, and dated; the margins carry the rest, which is where the real knowledge lives. A visitor who reads the ledger from the front learns the figures; one who reads the margins learns the place, and why the `harbour` entries change in the spring.

A second paragraph for the harbour, shorter, so that headings sit at varied distances from one another and a reflow moves each by a different amount.
